article.headline: Moncrieffe puts up 16, Seattle U downs Southern Utah 62-39
article.description: — Matthew-Alexander Moncrieffe scored 16 points as Seattle U beat Southern Utah 62-39 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Moncrieffe puts up 16, Seattle U downs Southern Utah 62-39

categories.description: Seattle U Redhawks @ Southern Utah Thunderbirds

event.description: Seattle U Redhawks @ Southern Utah Thunderbirds

keywords: Seattle U Redhawks @ Southern Utah Thunderbirds
article.story: CEDAR CITY, Utah -- — Matthew-Alexander Moncrieffe scored 16 points as Seattle U beat Southern Utah 62-39 on Thursday. Moncrieffe added 11 rebounds for the Redhawks (12-17, 7-8 Western Athletic Conference). Malek Gomma added 10 points while finishing 5 of 8 from the floor while they also had five rebounds. Paris Dawson had 10 points and went 4 of 9 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range). Kai Burdick finished with nine points, seven rebounds and two blocks for the Thunderbirds (12-18, 4-12). JT Langston Jr. added nine points for Southern Utah. Lorenzo Abellar also put up seven points. Seattle U visits Utah Tech in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
